sinopsis.es: En una habitación apartada del mundo real, Juan, de 10 años, vive con sus abuelos. Su abuelo expulsa grandes cantidades de materia por una extraña enfermedad y cada noche los visitan apariciones que se alimentan de su carne podrida. La abuela intenta ocultárselo, pero una noche Juan se escabulle para acercarse a ellas.
sinopsis.en: In a room isolated from the real world, 10-year-old Juan lives with his grandparents. A strange disease makes his grandfather expel large amounts of matter, and every night they are visited by apparitions that feed on his rotten flesh. The grandmother tries to hide it from him, but one night Juan sneaks out to approach them.
